# wso2is_application (Resource)

Manages an application, which the server also calls a service provider. The resource covers the application's sign-in protocols (OpenID Connect and OAuth2, SAML 2.0, WS-Federation and WS-Trust), its login flow, the user attributes that it requests, its roles and its advanced settings.

If you leave out a setting, the server uses its default value, and the provider shows that value in the state. If you later remove a setting from the configuration, the setting keeps its last value. To change it, set the new value explicitly.

Manage the API scopes that the application may request with `wso2is_application_authorized_api`. Share the application with sub-organizations with `wso2is_application_share`. To import an application, use its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# OpenID Connect web application with MFA and requested attributes.
resource "wso2is_application" "portal" {
  name        = "Customer Portal"
  description = "Self-service portal"
  access_url  = "https://portal.example.com"
  template_id = "oidc-web-application"

  oidc = {
    grant_types     = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
    callback_urls   = ["https://portal.example.com/callback"]
    allowed_origins = ["https://portal.example.com"]
    pkce = {
      mandatory = true
    }
    access_token = {
      type                                = "JWT"
      user_access_token_expiry_in_seconds = 900
    }
    refresh_token = {
      expiry_in_seconds   = 86400
      renew_refresh_token = true
    }
    logout = {
      back_channel_logout_url = "https://portal.example.com/logout/backchannel"
    }
  }

  claim_configuration = {
    requested_claims = [
      { uri = "http://wso2.org/claims/emailaddress", mandatory = true },
      { uri = "http://wso2.org/claims/givenname" },
    ]
  }

  authentication_sequence = {
    steps = [
      { options = [{ idp = "LOCAL", authenticator = "BasicAuthenticator" }] },
      { options = [{ idp = "LOCAL", authenticator = "totp" }, { idp = "LOCAL", authenticator = "email-otp-authenticator" }] },
    ]
  }

  advanced_configuration = {
    skip_login_consent = true
  }
}

# Machine-to-machine application (client credentials).
resource "wso2is_application" "backend" {
  name        = "Billing Service"
  template_id = "m2m-application"
  oidc = {
    grant_types = ["client_credentials"]
  }
}

# SAML 2.0 service provider.
resource "wso2is_application" "wiki" {
  name = "Wiki"
  saml = {
    issuer                  = "https://wiki.example.com/saml"
    assertion_consumer_urls = ["https://wiki.example.com/saml/acs"]
    single_sign_on_profile = {
      assertion = {
        name_id_format = "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress"
      }
    }
    attribute_profile = {
      enabled = true
    }
  }
}

output "portal_client_id" {
  value = wso2is_application.portal.oidc.client_id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique application name.

### Optional

- `access_url` (String) URL users open to reach the application (shown in My Account for discoverable applications).
- `advanced_configuration` (Attributes) Advanced application settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_configuration))
- `associated_roles` (Attributes) Which roles the application's users can be assigned and receive in tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_roles))
- `authentication_sequence` (Attributes) The login flow. It holds the authentication steps and an optional adaptive (conditional) authentication script. If you remove this block, the current flow stays as it is. To go back to the default flow, set `type = "DEFAULT"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication_sequence))
- `claim_configuration` (Attributes) User attributes (claims) the application requests and how the subject and roles are sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration))
- `description` (String) Description shown in the Console.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in to the application. The default is `true`.
- `enhanced_org_authentication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether enhanced organization authentication is enabled (organization login uses the organization's own login settings).
- `image_url` (String) Logo URL.
- `is_b2b_self_service_app` (Boolean) Whether the application is a B2B self-service application. The server only accepts this value when it creates the application, so changing it replaces the application.
- `is_management_app` (Boolean) Whether the application can call the management (system) APIs. The server only accepts this value when it creates the application, so changing it replaces the application.
- `logout_return_url` (String) The URL that users go to after they log out, when the application does not send one. When you clear this value, the server stores `.*`, which allows any URL. The provider shows `.*` as unset.
- `oidc` (Attributes) OpenID Connect / OAuth2 configuration. Remove the attribute to remove the protocol from the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc))
- `passive_sts` (Attributes) WS-Federation (passive STS) configuration. Remove the attribute to remove the protocol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--passive_sts))
- `provisioning` (Attributes) Inbound (SCIM) and outbound provisioning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning))
- `saml` (Attributes) SAML 2.0 web SSO configuration. Either configure it manually (`issuer` and `assertion_consumer_urls`) or point to the service provider metadata with `metadata_url`. Remove the attribute to remove the protocol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml))
- `template_id` (String) The Console template that the application was created from, for example `custom-application`, `m2m-application`, `single-page-application`, `oidc-web-application` or `react-application`. The template only changes how the Console shows the application.
- `template_version` (String) Version of the Console template.
- `ws_trust` (Attributes) WS-Trust configuration (needs the WS-Trust connector installed on the server). Remove the attribute to remove the protocol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ws_trust))

### Read-Only

- `access` (String) What the provider's user may do with this application. The value is `READ` for read-only system applications, and `WRITE` otherwise.
- `application_version` (String) Version of the application model on the server.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID, when OpenID Connect is configured.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `issuer` (String) SAML issuer, when SAML is configured.

<a id="nestedatt--advanced_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_configuration`

Optional:

- `attestation` (Attributes) Client attestation for app-native authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_configuration--attestation))
- `certificate` (Attributes) Application certificate used to validate signed requests and encrypt tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_configuration--certificate))
- `discoverable_by_end_users` (Boolean) Whether the application is listed in My Account. The default is `false`.
- `discoverable_groups` (Attributes Set) Groups whose members can discover the application in My Account. Empty means everyone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_configuration--discoverable_groups))
- `enable_api_based_authentication` (Boolean) Allow app-native (API based) authentication. The default is `false`.
- `enable_authorization` (Boolean) Engage authorization policies during authentication. The default is `false`.
- `return_authenticated_idp_list` (Boolean) Return the authenticated identity providers to the application. The default is `false`.
- `saas` (Boolean) Whether users of every tenant can sign in (super tenant only). The default is `false`.
- `skip_login_consent` (Boolean) Skip the attribute consent page at login. The default is `false`.
- `skip_logout_consent` (Boolean) Skip the logout confirmation page. The default is `false`.
- `trusted_app` (Attributes) Trusted (FIDO) application settings for passkeys in native apps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_configuration--trusted_app))
- `use_external_consent_page` (Boolean) Use an external consent page. The default is `false`.

Read-Only:

- `fragment` (Boolean) Whether this is a fragment (shared) application created by organization sharing.

<a id="nestedatt--advanced_configuration--attestation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_configuration.attestation`

Optional:

- `android_attestation_service_credentials` (String, Sensitive) The Google Play Integrity service account credentials, as JSON. The server never returns this value.
- `android_package_name` (String) Android package name.
- `apple_app_id` (String) Apple app ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Require client attestation. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--advanced_configuration--certificate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_configuration.certificate`

Optional:

- `type` (String) `PEM` or `JWKS`.
- `value` (String) PEM certificate, or the JWKS endpoint URL.


<a id="nestedatt--advanced_configuration--discoverable_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_configuration.discoverable_groups`

Required:

- `group_ids` (Set of String) Group IDs.
- `user_store` (String) User store domain of the groups, for example `PRIMARY`.


<a id="nestedatt--advanced_configuration--trusted_app"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_configuration.trusted_app`

Optional:

- `android_package_name` (String) Android package name.
- `android_thumbprints` (Set of String) Android signing certificate thumbprints.
- `apple_app_id` (String) Apple app ID.
- `is_consent_granted` (Boolean) Whether consent to publish the app details is granted. The default is `false`.
- `is_fido_trusted_app` (Boolean) Whether the app is a FIDO trusted app. The default is `false`.



<a id="nestedatt--associated_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `associated_roles`

Optional:

- `allowed_audience` (String) Which roles the application uses. With `APPLICATION`, the application only uses roles that were created for it. With `ORGANIZATION`, it uses the organization's roles. New applications use `APPLICATION` by default.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the roles that the application uses. Set this list when `allowed_audience = "ORGANIZATION"`. When `allowed_audience = "APPLICATION"`, the list is read-only and shows the roles that `wso2is_role` created for the application.


<a id="nestedatt--authentication_sequence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication_sequence`

Optional:

- `attribute_step_id` (Number) Step (1-based) whose user attributes are used.
- `request_path_authenticators` (List of String) Request path authenticators, for example `BasicAuthRequestPathAuthenticator` or `OAuthRequestPathAuthenticator`.
- `script` (String) Adaptive authentication script (JavaScript).
- `steps` (Attributes List) Authentication steps, in order. Each step lets the user choose one of its options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication_sequence--steps))
- `subject_step_id` (Number) Step (1-based) whose user identity is used as the subject.
- `type` (String) `DEFAULT` uses the tenant's default flow (username and password). `USER_DEFINED` uses `steps` and `script`. Set automatically to `USER_DEFINED` when `steps` or `script` are configured.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication_sequence--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication_sequence.steps`

Required:

- `options` (Attributes Set) Authenticators offered in this step (the login page shows them in the server's order). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication_sequence--steps--options))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication_sequence--steps--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication_sequence.steps.options`

Required:

- `authenticator` (String) Authenticator name, for example `BasicAuthenticator`, `totp`, `email-otp-authenticator`, `sms-otp-authenticator`, `FIDOAuthenticator`, `MagicLinkAuthenticator`, or a federated authenticator such as `GoogleOIDCAuthenticator` or `OpenIDConnectAuthenticator`.
- `idp` (String) `LOCAL` for local authenticators, otherwise the identity provider (connection) name.




<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration`

Optional:

- `claim_mappings` (Attributes Set) Maps the application's claim names to local claims. The `CUSTOM` dialect needs these mappings. With the `LOCAL` dialect, the server creates them from `requested_claims`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration--claim_mappings))
- `dialect` (String) `LOCAL` (use local claim URIs) or `CUSTOM` (map application claim names with `claim_mappings`).
- `requested_claims` (Attributes Set) The claims that the server shares with the application. With the `LOCAL` dialect, use local claim URIs (`http://wso2.org/claims/...`). With the `CUSTOM` dialect, use the application's claim names from `claim_mappings`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration--requested_claims))
- `role` (Attributes) How roles are sent to the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration--role))
- `subject` (Attributes) How the subject identifier is built. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration--subject))

<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration--claim_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration.claim_mappings`

Required:

- `application_claim` (String) Claim name the application receives.
- `local_claim` (String) Local claim URI.


<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration--requested_claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration.requested_claims`

Required:

- `uri` (String) Claim URI.

Optional:

- `mandatory` (Boolean) Whether the user must provide a value before signing in. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration.role`

Optional:

- `claim` (String) Claim carrying roles. The default is `http://wso2.org/claims/role`.
- `include_user_domain` (Boolean) Prefix role names with the user store domain. The default is `true`.
- `mappings` (Attributes Set) Local role to application role name mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_configuration--role--mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration--role--mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration.role.mappings`

Required:

- `application_role` (String) Role name sent to the application.
- `local_role` (String) Local role name.



<a id="nestedatt--claim_configuration--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_configuration.subject`

Optional:

- `claim` (String) Local claim used as the subject. The default is `http://wso2.org/claims/userid`.
- `include_tenant_domain` (Boolean) Suffix the subject with the tenant domain. The default is `false`.
- `include_user_domain` (Boolean) Prefix the subject with the user store domain. The default is `false`.
- `mapped_local_subject_mandatory` (Boolean) Fail federated logins that have no mapped local user. The default is `false`.
- `use_mapped_local_subject` (Boolean) Use the local user mapped to a federated user as the subject. The server turns it on when the application is shared with organizations.



<a id="nestedatt--oidc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc`

Required:

- `grant_types` (Set of String) Allowed grant types: `authorization_code`, `implicit`, `password`, `client_credentials`, `refresh_token`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:saml2-bearer`, `urn:openid:params:grant-type:ciba`, `organization_switch`, `iwa:ntlm`, `account_switch`.

Optional:

- `access_token` (Attributes) Access token settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--access_token))
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Origins allowed to call the OAuth2 endpoints from browsers (CORS).
- `callback_urls` (List of String) Authorized redirect URIs. A single value may be a regular expression prefixed with `regexp=`, for example `regexp=(https://a.example.com/cb|https://b.example.com/cb)`.
- `ciba` (Attributes) Client Initiated Backchannel Authentication settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--ciba))
- `client_authentication` (Attributes) Token endpoint client authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--client_authentication))
- `client_id` (String) The OAuth2 client ID. The server generates one when you do not set it. You can only choose the client ID when the application is created, so changing it replaces the application.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret. Generated when not set (empty for public clients). WSO2 only accepts a custom secret at creation, so changing it replaces the application.
- `hybrid_flow` (Attributes) Hybrid flow settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--hybrid_flow))
- `id_token` (Attributes) ID token settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--id_token))
- `is_fapi_application` (Boolean) Make the application FAPI conformant. The server only accepts this value at creation.
- `logout` (Attributes) OIDC logout endpoints of the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--logout))
- `pkce` (Attributes) PKCE settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--pkce))
- `public_client` (Boolean) Allow the client to authenticate without a secret (single page and mobile apps). WSO2 still generates a client secret, which public clients do not use. The default is `false`.
- `refresh_token` (Attributes) Refresh token settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--refresh_token))
- `request_object` (Attributes) Request object settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--request_object))
- `require_pushed_authorization_requests` (Boolean) Only accept authorization requests sent through PAR. The default is `false`.
- `scope_validators` (Set of String) Scope validators, for example `Role based scope validator`.
- `subject` (Attributes) Subject identifier type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--subject))
- `subject_token` (Attributes) Subject token issuance for token exchange (impersonation). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--subject_token))
- `token_issuer_organization_id` (String) The organization whose issuer signs the tokens. This setting only applies to applications inside an organization, that is, with a provider that sets `organization_id`. By default, the root organization signs the tokens. To make the application's own organization the issuer, set its organization ID. In the root organization, the value is `""`.
- `validate_request_object_signature` (Boolean) Require signed request objects. The default is `false`.

Read-Only:

- `state` (String) `ACTIVE` or `REVOKED`.

<a id="nestedatt--oidc--access_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.access_token`

Optional:

- `access_token_attributes` (Set of String) User attributes (claim names) included in JWT access tokens.
- `application_access_token_expiry_in_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of tokens issued to the application (client credentials).
- `binding_type` (String) Token binding: `None`, `cookie`, `sso-session`, `certificate`, `DPoP`, `client-request`.
- `enable_jwt_scope_as_array` (Boolean) Send the `scope` claim of JWT access tokens as an array. The default is `false`.
- `revoke_tokens_when_idp_session_terminated` (Boolean) Revoke tokens when the user's login session ends. The default is `false`.
- `type` (String) Token format: `Default` (opaque) or `JWT`.
- `user_access_token_expiry_in_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of tokens issued to users.
- `validate_token_binding` (Boolean) Validate the token binding on API calls. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--ciba"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.ciba`

Optional:

- `allow_federated_users` (Boolean) Allow notifications to users not in the local user store. The default is `false`.
- `auth_request_expiry_time` (Number) Authentication request expiry in seconds.
- `notification_channels` (Set of String) Allowed notification channels, for example `email`, `sms`, `external`.
- `skip_user_validation` (Boolean) Skip validating that the authenticated user matches `login_hint`. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--client_authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.client_authentication`

Optional:

- `tls_client_auth_subject_dn` (String) Expected certificate subject DN for `tls_client_auth`.
- `token_endpoint_allow_reuse_pvt_key_jwt` (Boolean) Allow reusing a private key JWT (only with `private_key_jwt`). The default is `false`.
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) `client_secret_basic`, `client_secret_post`, `private_key_jwt`, `tls_client_auth`. Empty means any method.
- `token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg` (String) Signing algorithm for `private_key_jwt`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--hybrid_flow"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.hybrid_flow`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow the hybrid flow. The default is `false`.
- `response_type` (String) Comma separated allowed response types, for example `code id_token`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--id_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.id_token`

Optional:

- `audience` (Set of String) Additional audiences.
- `encryption` (Attributes) ID token encryption. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc--id_token--encryption))
- `expiry_in_seconds` (Number) ID token lifetime.
- `signed_response_alg` (String) Signing algorithm, for example `RS256` or `PS256`.

<a id="nestedatt--oidc--id_token--encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.id_token.encryption`

Optional:

- `algorithm` (String) Key encryption algorithm, for example `RSA-OAEP`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Encrypt ID tokens (needs an application certificate). The default is `false`.
- `method` (String) Content encryption method, for example `A128GCM`.



<a id="nestedatt--oidc--logout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.logout`

Optional:

- `back_channel_logout_url` (String) Back-channel logout URL.
- `front_channel_logout_url` (String) Front-channel logout URL.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--pkce"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.pkce`

Optional:

- `mandatory` (Boolean) Require PKCE. The default is `false`.
- `support_plain_transform_algorithm` (Boolean) Accept the `plain` code challenge method. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--refresh_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.refresh_token`

Optional:

- `expiry_in_seconds` (Number) Refresh token lifetime.
- `extend_renewed_refresh_token_expiry_time` (Boolean) Give renewed refresh tokens a full new lifetime. When not set, the server derives it from `renew_refresh_token`.
- `renew_refresh_token` (Boolean) Issue a new refresh token on every refresh.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--request_object"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.request_object`

Optional:

- `encryption_algorithm` (String) Request object key encryption algorithm.
- `encryption_method` (String) Request object content encryption method.
- `signing_alg` (String) Expected request object signing algorithm.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.subject`

Optional:

- `sector_identifier_uri` (String) Sector identifier URI for pairwise subjects.
- `subject_type` (String) `public` or `pairwise`. The default is `public`.


<a id="nestedatt--oidc--subject_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc.subject_token`

Optional:

- `application_subject_token_expiry_in_seconds` (Number) Subject token lifetime.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Issue subject tokens. The default is `false`.



<a id="nestedatt--passive_sts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `passive_sts`

Required:

- `realm` (String) Realm (wtrealm) of the relying party.
- `reply_to` (String) URL tokens are posted to.

Optional:

- `reply_to_logout` (String) URL users return to after logout.


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning`

Optional:

- `inbound` (Attributes) Users and groups provisioned through SCIM by this application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--inbound))
- `outbound_identity_providers` (Attributes List) Identity providers users are provisioned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--outbound_identity_providers))

<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--inbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.inbound`

Optional:

- `provisioning_userstore_domain` (String) User store that receives provisioned users (when not in proxy mode).
- `proxy_mode` (Boolean) Forward provisioning requests to outbound connectors without storing users locally. The default is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--outbound_identity_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.outbound_identity_providers`

Required:

- `connector` (String) Outbound provisioning connector name, for example `scim2`, `googleapps`, `salesforce`.
- `idp` (String) Identity provider name.

Optional:

- `blocking` (Boolean) Wait for provisioning to finish.
- `jit` (Boolean) Provision just-in-time provisioned users too.
- `rules` (Boolean) Apply provisioning rules.



<a id="nestedatt--saml"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml`

Optional:

- `assertion_consumer_urls` (List of String) Assertion consumer service URLs.
- `attribute_profile` (Attributes) Attribute statement settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--attribute_profile))
- `default_assertion_consumer_url` (String) Default ACS URL. The default is the first of `assertion_consumer_urls`.
- `enable_assertion_query_profile` (Boolean) Enable the assertion query/request profile. The default is `false`.
- `idp_entity_id_alias` (String) IdP entity ID used for this service provider. The default is the resident IdP entity ID.
- `issuer` (String) SAML issuer (entity ID) of the service provider.
- `metadata_url` (String) Service provider metadata URL. The server reads issuer, ACS URLs and certificates from it when the protocol is configured.
- `request_validation` (Attributes) Authentication request validation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--request_validation))
- `response_signing` (Attributes) Response signing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--response_signing))
- `service_provider_qualifier` (String) Qualifier to allow several service providers with the same issuer.
- `single_logout_profile` (Attributes) Single logout settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--single_logout_profile))
- `single_sign_on_profile` (Attributes) SSO profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile))

<a id="nestedatt--saml--attribute_profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.attribute_profile`

Optional:

- `always_include_attributes_in_response` (Boolean) Include attributes even when not requested. The default is `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Include an attribute statement. The default is `false`.
- `name_format` (String) Attribute name format URI.


<a id="nestedatt--saml--request_validation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.request_validation`

Optional:

- `enable_signature_validation` (Boolean) Require signed authentication requests.
- `signature_validation_cert_alias` (String) Alias of the certificate used to validate request signatures.


<a id="nestedatt--saml--response_signing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.response_signing`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Sign SAML responses.
- `signing_algorithm` (String) Signing algorithm URI.


<a id="nestedatt--saml--single_logout_profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.single_logout_profile`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable single logout. The default is `false`.
- `idp_initiated_single_logout` (Attributes) IdP initiated single logout. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--single_logout_profile--idp_initiated_single_logout))
- `logout_method` (String) `BACKCHANNEL`, `FRONTCHANNEL_HTTP_REDIRECT` or `FRONTCHANNEL_HTTP_POST`.
- `logout_request_url` (String) URL that accepts logout requests.
- `logout_response_url` (String) URL that accepts logout responses.

<a id="nestedatt--saml--single_logout_profile--idp_initiated_single_logout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.single_logout_profile.idp_initiated_single_logout`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow IdP initiated logout. The default is `false`.
- `return_to_urls` (Set of String) Allowed return URLs.



<a id="nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.single_sign_on_profile`

Optional:

- `assertion` (Attributes) Assertion settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile--assertion))
- `bindings` (Set of String) Allowed bindings: `HTTP_POST`, `HTTP_REDIRECT`, `ARTIFACT`.
- `enable_idp_initiated_single_sign_on` (Boolean) Allow IdP initiated SSO. The default is `false`.
- `enable_signature_validation_for_artifact_binding` (Boolean) Validate signatures of artifact resolve requests. The default is `false`.

Read-Only:

- `attribute_consuming_service_index` (String) Attribute consuming service index assigned by the server.

<a id="nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile--assertion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.single_sign_on_profile.assertion`

Optional:

- `audiences` (Set of String) Additional audiences.
- `digest_algorithm` (String) Digest algorithm URI.
- `encryption` (Attributes) Assertion encryption. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile--assertion--encryption))
- `name_id_format` (String) NameID format, for example `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`.
- `recipients` (Set of String) Additional recipients.

<a id="nestedatt--saml--single_sign_on_profile--assertion--encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.single_sign_on_profile.assertion.encryption`

Optional:

- `assertion_encryption_algorithm` (String) Assertion encryption algorithm URI.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Encrypt assertions (needs the service provider certificate). The default is `false`.
- `key_encryption_algorithm` (String) Key encryption algorithm URI.





<a id="nestedatt--ws_trust"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ws_trust`

Required:

- `audience` (String) Audience (endpoint address) of the trusted service.
- `certificate_alias` (String) Alias of the service's certificate in the tenant keystore.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_application.portal 5f6b7c8d-1234-4cde-9abc-0123456789ab
```
